# fivecentplots

> Wrapper for matplotlib, plotly, and bokeh that simplifies generating complex,
> publication-quality plots directly from pandas DataFrames using a single consistent
> keyword-argument API across all three backends.

- [Agent reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/endangeredoxen/fivecentplots/main/AGENTS.md): Complete per-function and universal kwarg tables, naming conventions for unlisted kwargs, and known gotchas. Start here for any code-generation task involving this library.
- [README](https://github.com/endangeredoxen/fivecentplots/blob/main/README.md): Human-facing overview, install instructions, and design philosophy.
- [Full documentation](https://endangeredoxen.github.io/fivecentplots/): Sphinx docs with rendered example plots for every feature.
- [Valid kwargs list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/endangeredoxen/fivecentplots/main/src/fivecentplots/kwargs/kwargs_all.txt): Flat text file of every kwarg name the library will accept without a warning — useful for a quick membership check before calling.
